name: first-through
description: A Mythras Imperative campaign for mythras-gm, built as a first roleplaying game for 10-15 year olds and set in the real stellar neighbourhood. Nine hundred and seventy-five years ago seedships carried anchor pairs out at a twentieth of lightspeed; where one arrived, a door opened, and that is the only way between stars. Two one-sitting entry points -- one investigation, one boarding action -- four pre-generated first-throughs, and a living world of 13 agendas and 24 beats. Nobody dies.
